review_comments:
Let's no overload them with a lot of sensors enabled by default.  Please add
```
        entity_category=EntityCategory.DIAGNOSTIC,
        entity_registry_enabled_default=False,
```
This one as well and I think we are good to merge this PR

Since outlet_voltage for PDUs is parallel output_voltage for UPSs, would it make sense to leave this one as a sensor (if the device has it).  I suggest we instead make input_current_status into a diagnostic and disabled by default so that it is parallel input_voltage_status per your other request.  Let me know if you want input_current_status turned back to an enabled main sensor and really want outlet_voltage disabled/diagnostic.

Let's no overload them with a lot of sensors enabled by default.  Please add
```
        entity_category=EntityCategory.DIAGNOSTIC,
        entity_registry_enabled_default=False,
```
